name: nixpkgs-tracker
title: NixPkgs PR Tracker
description: See which NixPkgs branches contain a pull request.
author: e-kontsevoy

commands.name: track-pr
commands.title: Track NixPkgs PR
commands.description: Track a PR through staging, master and NixPkgs channels.

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Personal Access Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Alternatively, use Sign in with GitHub in the command. A manual token takes precedence over GitHub sign-in. Public read access is sufficient.

preferences.name: branches
preferences.title: Branches to Check
preferences.description: Comma-separated Git refs. The PR's target branch is also checked automatically.
preferences.default: staging, staging-next, master, nixpkgs-unstable, nixos-unstable-small, nixos-unstable
